title: A line of an initial state (initial_state.jsonl) v0.3.0
description: One line of the JSONL file that a cell puts into an empty chronicle at startup. The rest of the gram (type, subtype, legal basis, chronicle, actor and the hash of the stream) follows from the stream; recorded_at is the load time. The fields must be exactly those of the event, which the runtime checks against the stream.

stream.description: The id of a stream of the cell.

effective_at.description: When the fact legally holds or took place, set by hand; not after the load time.

provenance.description: An initial-state gram is placed, not computed.

id.description: Without it the gram gets a fixed id derived from the line itself.

refers_to.description: Per name of the event's references: the id of an earlier gram of the initial state.

fields.description: The fields of the gram, as the event declares them.
